label: Scheduler
description: What keeps this tree's schedule. A project's startup list names `run` to start it: nothing fires on a clock of its own, so a tree that does not ask to be scheduled is not. The schedule is the scheduled triggers themselves -- this operation names none of them.

run.description: Keep this tree's schedule until the process stops: at every instant a scheduled trigger's cron expression or interval names, fire its operation and log what it answered. Answers what it found, so a startup report says how many triggers are scheduled and when the earliest next tick falls.

lease.description: the path of a connection document whose kind declares `leases`, on which a tick is held so that one instance of several fires it; absent: this process assumes it is alone and fires every tick itself

triggers.description: how many scheduled triggers the tree has

next.description: the earliest next tick of any of them, ISO 8601 in UTC; absent where the tree has no scheduled trigger
